reserveReview.rationale: Reviewed both pages of Fact Finance's September 30, 2026 BRLV technical verification memo, linked by Crown's Portuguese transparency index. Its reserve rows reconcile exactly to R$377,991,098.61: R$361,119,074.57 in Brazilian Treasury bonds, R$16,872,013.84 in Brazilian Treasury ETFs, and R$10.20 in cash/equivalents. Category weights are computed from those stated balances to eight decimal places, retaining the cash row rather than assigning its weight to government securities. The memo reports R$377,989,540.00 of BRLV liabilities and R$1,558.61 excess reserves; no surplus credit or deployment-level supply claim is inferred. It still labels the network Base but links 0xd7ca0e2c36d647446b782d1b72308e598373e2f5, which Crown's official address table identifies as Ethereum BRLV; Base BRLV is 0xd2047ebdb205ee6862b69ae9fb3501652cc97d36. The report is signed by Rodrigo Molin da Silva and prints CRC PR-052428/O and CNAI 10106, but describes technical PoR procedures without an identified financial-assurance standard or assurance opinion. The new signature does not establish an upgraded assurance method or attestor tier.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Fact Finance BRLV technical verification memo dated September 30, 2026, section 3; each category's reported BRL balances divided by the exact total R$377,991,098.61, expressed as percentages to eight decimal places.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The September 30 memo identifies every reserve category and balance but omits security identifiers, maturity maxima, fund issuers and look-through, reserve-account institutions, and provider-level allocations. Liquidity horizons remain unknown. Its printed report date is the composition date; the public posting date is not established. The Portuguese index currently links this September memo, whereas earlier English-index research identified August as newest. The repeated Base/Ethereum contract-label mismatch prevents treating this memo as an exact deployment census. Its technical procedures and printed accountant credentials do not establish a financial-assurance engagement.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The September 18, 2026 binding terms identify Banco Genial S.A. as the reserve-asset custodian, Krona Two S.à.r.l., a Luxembourg SPV, as guarantor and reserve-account holder, and Vórtx Serviços Fiduciários Ltda. (CNPJ 17.595.680/0001-36) as the security agent holding fiduciary liens registered in SELIC/B3. No provider-level allocations are disclosed, so no shares are asserted. The terms describe segregation and enforcement upon specified defaults, with KYC, notice, cure-period and coverage exclusions; the orphan guarantor has two independent directors and Dutch stichting ownership, while remaining within Crown's economic group for governance and reporting. Rehypothecation terms remain unverified.
